description: Opus X unit B4: runMove's AfterMove sees the move Sleep Talk called (`if (this.battle.activeMove) move = this.battle.activeMove`). Setup turn: Kilowattrel's Sleep Talk fails (awake), Whimsicott's Tailwind gives Wind Power Kilowattrel `charge`, Amoonguss's Spore puts it to sleep. The turn: Kilowattrel's Sleep Talk calls Shock Wave (its only other move) at a random foe, doubled by Charge; Charge's onAfterMove sees the Electric Shock Wave and ends the charge.
